# Rinova AI
> AI-powered real estate photo enhancement tool

Rinova AI instantly uplifts real estate listing photos using artificial intelligence.
Upload property photos and receive professional-quality enhanced images in seconds.
Supports single-room enhancements, multi-angle batch projects, and AI-generated video flythroughs.

## Product
- [Home](https://rinova.capmapai.com/)
- [Plans & Pricing](https://rinova.capmapai.com/plans)
- [Sign Up](https://rinova.capmapai.com/register)
- [Sign In](https://rinova.capmapai.com/login)

## Features
- AI virtual staging in multiple styles (Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Bohemian, Minimalist, Contemporary)
- Automatic room type detection
- Batch multi-angle project processing
- AI video flythrough generation
- HEIC / iPhone photo support
- Instant download of enhanced images

## Company
Rinova AI is a SaaS product by CapMap AI — https://capmapai.com
